A short, public summary appears below.

## Position

**University of Arkansas at Little Rock** — faculty in mathematics and
statistics; director of the Math Assistance Center.

## Research interests

- Bias-robust Bayesian meta-analysis (RoBMA, model-averaged Bayes
  factors, selection models).
- Publication bias and evidential fragility in applied literatures.
- Nutrition and health evidence synthesis.
- Replication and reanalysis in education research.
- Reproducible statistical workflows (R, Quarto, Git, simulation).
- Statistics education, including Bayesian intuition at the introductory
  level and responsible use of AI tools.
- Human-governed AI and curriculum infrastructure, including a
  course-authoring harness for governed courseware.

See the [Research page](research.qmd) for current project descriptions.

## Teaching and service

- Undergraduate and graduate teaching in mathematics and statistics.
- Director of the Math Assistance Center (MAC) at UA Little Rock.
- Maintainer of a public mathematics and statistics course-material
  portfolio (the [Course Library](courses.qmd)).
- Developer of a human-governed course-authoring harness for AI-assisted
  curriculum work.

See the [Teaching page](teaching.qmd) for current courses.

## Selected work

**Preprint.** Hester, M. *Quantifying Evidential Rigor in Meta-Analytic
Corpora: A Simulation-Characterized, Bias-Robust Bayesian Workflow with a
Nutrition Case Study.* Public preprint, arXiv:2606.01428.

- arXiv preprint: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01428>
- Companion repository:
  <https://github.com/matthewahester/evidential-audit-workflow>
- Archived companion repository (Zenodo):
  <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20467258>

See the [Research page](research.qmd) for a plain-language description.

**System development.** *Governed courseware.* A human-governed
course-authoring harness (repo-native analytic exoskeleton) for AI-assisted
curriculum work. Its current public demonstration layer is the public
course-material portfolio. See the
[Research page](research.qmd#governed-courseware) and the
[Course Library](courses.qmd).
